statement: Let λ⊢N index the polynomial Schubert cell X^λ and μ=2^s 1^r with 2s+r=N. For a real monic Wronskian g with r distinct real roots and s conjugate pairs of nonreal roots, the number N_g of real points in the Wronski fibre, counted with algebraic multiplicity, satisfies |χ^λ(μ)|≤N_g≤f^λ. Here χ^λ is the irreducible S_N character and f^λ=χ^λ(1^N) is the standard-tableau count. For Gr(k,n) take the rectangle λ=(n−k)^k and N=k(n−k).

answer.qualification: A lower bound on each prescribed root-type stratum; it is not asserted to be the sharp minimum.

scope: Real fibres of the Wronski map on X^λ over the indicated real-root-type stratum. Nonreal roots may repeat as permitted in the source; for regular fibres algebraic multiplicities are 1.
notes:
Primary PDF downloaded and Theorem 1.3/Corollary 1.4 inspected on 2026-11-04. This supplements the Eremenko–Gabrielov parity-dependent lower bound already present. The lower-bound interpretation is a direct consequence of the source’s character-oriented topological degree.

Levinson–Purbhoo explicitly identify Corollary 1.4 as a special case of Mukhin–Tarasov’s lower-bound theorem. Their character-orientation proof is retained as the verification source.

The following bibliography supplies historical attribution or supporting background for the result. Evgeny Mukhin, Vitaly Tarasov, Lower bounds for numbers of real solutions in problems of Schubert calculus (2016, mukhin_2014_real_lower).
